name: pi-web-app
description: Local-first browser workspace for coding-agent runtimes

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @pi-web/contracts build && pnpm --filter @pi-web/agent-runtime build && pnpm --filter @pi-web/pi-adapter build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm test:packages && vitest run apps/server/src/app.test.ts apps/server/src/db/store.test.ts apps/server/src/inspector
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:docs && pnpm docs:check
